admission.justification: Proved by test_copy_package_folder_replaces_stray_file_and_refuses_symlink and prevents a stray regular file at starters/ or exemplar/ from breaking workspace preparation while preserving symlink confinement refusal.

applicability: Refreshing shipped read-only package folders such as starters/ and exemplar/ inside an explainer workspace during workspace preparation.
conditions: The destination lies under the guarded workspace root and holds an existing regular non-symlink file, directory, or symlink.
exclusions: User-authored draft files under drafts/ or published snapshots under revisions/.
statement: Reseeding the explainer starter or exemplar folder unlinks a stray regular file at the destination path before copying package files while continuing to refuse a symlink.
title: Explainer package reseeding replaces stray regular files while refusing symlinks
